why: final-v1 rebased onto the SLEEVED list scanned 2026-09-17. final-v1 was opened against a decklist five cards wrong, and against the corrected list it would REVERT four cards the pilot has in sleeves — Fabled Passage, Forbidden Orchard, Prismatic Vista and Tarnished Citadel back in, Wooded Foothills and Talisman of Dominance out. Same intent: the seven spell swaps plus the four fetchlands not already sleeved. The objective is interaction rather than a clock because the half of this branch that is not lands is protection and a counterspell, and the land half is a colour-access question the goldfish cannot rank at all.

commits.message: final-v1's intent, rebased onto the sleeved list: 7 spell swaps and the 4 fetchlands not already in paper
Hallowed Fountain for a Forest: an Island-typed target for the blue fetches
Irrigated Farmland and Cascade Bluffs for the two remaining at-target lands

staged.why: final-v1's one authored swap: a single-job tutor for a protection enchantment; Sarkhan's Triumph stays as the instant-speed Dragon tutor.

staged.in: Marang River Regent // Coil and Catch
staged.why: The mana pass: blue read 16 sources against a Karsten target. A UU Dragon that also bounces, against a red six-drop whose haste grant needs another Dragon already out.
Eight mana for a token engine that needs to connect first, for a UU Dragon two mana cheaper.
An anthem that needs a wide board this deck does not build, for a Dragon with a second mode.

Return grants NO TRAMPLE and is stopped by a single chump block, which the Golgari finisher research confirmed independently; its real job was the draw mode. Steel Hellkite is a colourless body with a repeatable board answer.
Six mana to draw off a creature that has to survive, for three mana of instant-speed indestructible and a free equip that protects the commander.
A red planeswalker whose loyalty needs defending, for a one-mana counter that is Force Spike until a Dragon lands and then answers a wrath.
The mana pass: a painland for a fetch.
The mana pass: a conditional-untapped dual for a fetch.
The mana pass: a conditional-untapped dual for a fetch.
The mana pass: the last of the four fetches final-v1 wanted that is not already sleeved.

Green reads +4 OVER its Karsten target while blue is short by 13, and mana-fit names Forest as a cut candidate for making only colours already at target. Hallowed Fountain is ISLAND-TYPED, so all three blue fetches in the branch can find it — the deck had only three blue-typed lands total for them to fetch. Owned.

mana-fit names Canopy Vista a cut candidate: GW, and both colours now read at or over target while blue is short 11. Irrigated Farmland is the second ISLAND-TYPED land the blue fetches can find, and it cycles when it is the wrong half. Owned. It enters tapped, which is the cost.

The last Plains makes only a colour at target. Cascade Bluffs filters into UU or RR, which is exactly the two costs this branch adds — Marang River Regent and Transcendent Dragon are both {4}{U}{U}. Owned. It needs another land first, which is the cost.
